extDescription.message: Folds reviewer-agreed Go code (getters, no-op methods, if err != nil) in GitHub PR diffs, taking review off your hands.

fileShowTitle.message: Show the $lines$ that gotebanare hid in this file

fileHideTitle.message: Hide the $lines$ in this file again

bannerConfigError.message: $path$ has errors, so nothing is hidden.

bannerConfigChanged.message: This pull request changes $path$. Folds follow the base branch config.

bannerHeadPreview.message: Previewing with the head branch config $path$. The pull request author controls this config.

bannerConfigFetchFailed.message: Nothing is hidden because the config $path$ could not be loaded. $reason$

fetchNotFound.message: GitHub could not find the file at this commit.

fetchUnauthorized.message: GitHub denied access. Sign in to GitHub and reload the page.

fetchSso.message: Your organization requires single sign-on. Authorize your SSO session and reload the page.

fetchNetwork.message: The request failed because of a network error.

fetchTooLarge.message: The file is larger than 1 MiB.

bannerUnsupportedUi.message: This GitHub diff layout is not supported yet, so nothing is hidden.

bannerSplitView.message: Split view is not supported yet. Switch to the unified view to fold code.

bannerSourceMismatch.message: Nothing is hidden in $path$ because the page does not match the analyzed source.

bannerContextError.message: Could not read the pull request commits from this page, so nothing is hidden.

bannerAnalysisFailed.message: Nothing is hidden in $path$ because the analysis failed: $error$

popupNoPage.message: Open a pull request's Files changed tab.

popupStateNoConfigHead.message: No .gotebanare.yml or .gotebanare.yaml on the head branch

popupHeadPreviewActive.message: Previewing with the head branch config. The pull request author controls this config.

optionsExcludedHelp.message: One pattern per line: owner/name, owner/*, or * for every repository. Case is ignored.

optionsDebugHelp.message: Outline code that would be hidden instead of hiding it, and list the matched rules on hover.

optionsNotSaved.message: Not saved. Fix the lines below. Each line needs owner/name, owner/*, or *.

optionsLoadFailed.message: Could not load the saved options: $error$
